data.name: John
data.gender_notes: John is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Yoḥanan, 'Yahweh is gracious', via the Greek Ioannes and the Latin Iohannes. Its root is Hebrew y-ḥ-n-n. John the Baptist and John the Apostle. John is a Hebrew name meaning “God is gracious”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: John expresses “God is gracious”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Hebrew Yoḥanan, 'Yahweh is gracious', via the Greek Ioannes and the Latin Iohannes.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of John total 20, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.

faq.q: From which word is John derived?
faq.a: From the Hebrew Yoḥanan, 'Yahweh is gracious', via the Greek Ioannes and the Latin Iohannes.

faq.q: Is John mentioned in scripture or history?
faq.a: John the Baptist and John the Apostle.

faq.q: What is the historical or scriptural reference for John?
faq.a: John the Baptist and John the Apostle.

faq.q: What is the lucky number for John?
faq.a: The Pythagorean lucky number for John is 2 (ruling planet Moon). This is an interpretive association, not a factual claim.

faq.q: Which day is associated with John?
faq.a: Monday is the traditional association for John. This is interpretive.

faq.q: Which gemstone is associated with John?
faq.a: Pearl is the traditional association for John. This is interpretive.

faq.q: Which colours are associated with John?
faq.a: White, Silver are the traditional associations for John. These are interpretive.

faq.q: What is the numerology of John?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of John total 20, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.

faq.q: How reliable is the meaning given for John?
faq.a: The meaning of John carries confidence HIGH in this record. It is established by classical lexicography or scripture.

faq.q: Does John have a religious meaning?
faq.a: John is recorded as a christian name meaning “God is gracious”.

faq.q: What is the English meaning of John?
faq.a: In English, John is rendered as “God is gracious”.

faq.q: Is John suitable for a baby?
faq.a: John is used as a male given name; suitability is a personal choice.
